explanation.question_quote: ST elevations on his EKG and elevated cardiac enzymes
explanation.sentence: The patient has sudden chest pain radiating to the left shoulder, diaphoresis, ST elevations, and elevated cardiac enzymes.
This presentation indicates an acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction, which can impair ventricular contractility.
Reduced contractility lowers stroke volume and thereby tends to decrease cardiac output.
The fall in effective arterial perfusion triggers sympathetic vasoconstriction, increasing systemic vascular resistance to help maintain arterial pressure.
